summary: All 5 acceptance criteria verified against implementation and test suite. 264 tests pass (213 unit + 4 main + 12 e2e + 35 integration), including the real auth-server token validation test that spawns slice1-lab/auth-server and validates its issued token end-to-end.
follow_up: OIDC discovery fallback (/.well-known/openid-configuration) is implemented in oauth.rs:327,331-334 but has no dedicated integration test; only the RFC 8414 form is exercised by the phase3 tests.
important_context: The phase3_real_auth_server_token_validates test requires PostgreSQL at postgres://oidc:oidc-lab-only@127.0.0.1:5432/oidc and Node.js; it skips (not fails) when unavailable (helper exit 100).

The mcp_service.rs CommonCalServer is the rmcp-backed service wired in main.rs:52-80 with auth_middleware; the legacy gateway.rs dispatcher is still present but the production path uses the rmcp service.
